summary: Bank-fee approval slice: BankCharge gains the approval chain (submitted_by/at, approved_by/at, reject_reason) through a costing migration 0004 whose trigger replaces the PH-244 draft-only guard with draft-edit/submit/decide transitions that freeze published facts and keep BankCharge.version unchanged except for draft revisions. The costing service adds submit (draft->pending, records submitter) and independent decide (pending->approved/rejected, records approver and mandatory rejection reason; creator/submitter cannot decide), with company lock, period/lock/future checks, per-action BankChargeReceipt idempotency (same token replay without new writes, changed input conflict) and one-winner semantics. Approval posts exactly one company cost fact set in the same transaction: one SourceConsumption claim (consumer=cost, coverage_key=bank_charge:<id>, amount=gross, source=bank_charge ref), one core AccountingEvent (event_type=costing.bank_charge.cost, frozen occurred_on/posting_period, effect=gross) and one LedgerPosting (book=cost, origin=current, scope=project, amount=gross), with generic audits submitted/approved/rejected/cost_posted and no new canonical topic (per spec; saved event stays only on the save path). core.services.decide_document implements the core.document.decide bank_charge handler (private service/browser workflow, command channel not exposed). Views/forms/templates add submit, independent approve and reject plus approval-chain/cost display. verify_integrity now accepts the five statuses, validates the approval chain, requires no cost facts for unapproved states and validates exactly one complete cost fact set when present for approved charges (PH-253-compatible transitional allowance when absent), with orphan cost-event/stray-claim detection and labor-loop allowlisting of the fee cost event. No cash fact, ledger cash/bank posting, settlement/open-item or ReceiptFeeSettlement write is made. Independent fresh-context S review returned PASS with 0 blockers (HEAD ed3e742, BASE 1f02520; 20 changed files all inside the PH-250 allowed_paths); its five non-blocking notes (PH-253/PH-250 verify_integrity conflict resolution at integration; UI can_decide UUID/string normalization; defence-in-depth re-assertion of frozen slice fields; approved transitional state; browser/PG coverage) are recorded in unverified for integration/PH-251 follow-up.

findings: STATE MACHINE / INDEPENDENT APPROVAL / COST FACTS VERIFIED: BankCharge gains submitted_by/at, approved_by/at and reject_reason through costing migration 0004, which replaces the PH-244 draft-only triggers with a v2 guard: insert only draft/version 1/no chain; draft->draft revision version+1 with no chain; draft->pending version unchanged with facts frozen and only submitter set; pending->approved/rejected version unchanged, facts frozen, submitter unchanged, approver required, approved has no reason and rejected requires one; approved/rejected are terminal and deletes are blocked. The service adds company-locked submit (draft->pending, records submitter) and independent decide (pending->approved/rejected; creator/submitter cannot decide; rejection requires a 1..1000-char reason; period/lock/future checks; per-action BankChargeReceipt idempotency with replay/changed-input conflict), and approval posts in the same transaction exactly one cost fact set: one SourceConsumption claim (consumer=cost, coverage_key=bank_charge:<id>, amount=gross, source=bank_charge ref, source_id=charge id), one core AccountingEvent (event_type=costing.bank_charge.cost, frozen occurred_on/posting_period, algorithm bank_fee_cost_v1, effect=gross, linked claim) and one LedgerPosting (book=cost, origin=current, scope=project, scope_id=charge project, amount=gross). No canonical topic/command is added (approval writes only generic audits/submitted/approved/rejected/cost_posted + the core AccountingEvent), and no cash transaction, ledger cash/bank posting, settlement/open item, ReceiptFeeSettlement or existing_cost_ref write is made (scoped fact-tuple tests confirm). core.services.decide_document is the named bank_charge handler (only kind accepted; no PAT/MCP/public canonical wiring), routed through the costing browser action view.

VERIFY_INTEGRITY REVIEW: the fee branch accepts the canonical five statuses, validates the approval chain (pending/approved/rejected need a submitter; approved/rejected need an approver different from creator/submitter; approved cannot carry a reason; rejected requires one), requires zero cost facts for draft/pending/rejected/superseded, and for approved-with-facts validates exactly one complete claim/event/posting set with the correct consumer/coverage/amount/event type/frozen period/claim link/book/origin/scope/amount; approved without facts is accepted as the PH-253-compatible transition. Orphan cost events and stray fee claims are reported, and the labor AccountingEvent loop allowlists exactly source=costing/kind=bank_charge so the fee cost event is validated only here. The tests exercise approved valid/duplicate/missing-posting/amount-mismatch/self-approval/unapproved-cost-fact probes; the probe DB duplicate-cost-event path is covered.

(d) approved without cost facts is the declared transitional state; PH-250's own approval path always posts the fact set. (e) browser 1440/390 and PG double-connection concurrent decide remain unverified locally (HTTP tests + company/row locks; CI for PG).
